description: This file defines the SocketReceiver class, which handles asynchronous socket data reception using pipelines in the Orleans networking library.

classes.name: SocketReceiver
classes.description: A class that manages asynchronous socket data reception, inheriting from SocketSenderReceiverBase.

methods.name: WaitForDataAsync
methods.description: Prepares to wait asynchronously for data on the socket, returning a SocketAwaitableEventArgs object.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Receives data asynchronously into the provided buffer, returning a SocketAwaitableEventArgs object.
